title: Report On Arms Seizures By Local Customs Authorities Since January 1926

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 20,000-1-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.B. D 1455.

REPORT
Special Branch No. 2 Station,
Date July 29, 1930.

Subject (in full) Arms seizures by local Customs Authorities since January 1926.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,
With reference to attached letter dated June 26th
1930 from the Bombay Police re: seizures of smuggled
arms during the past five years, I beg to forward herewith
a list of all arms seized by the Customs Authorities and
River Police from January 1926 up to present date.
Numerous seizures have also been made by the S.M.P.
during that period, but although it was well known that the
arms must have been smuggled into Shanghai, there was no
possibility of tracing the source as the firearms had, as
a rule, passed through several hands before being seized.
In the absence of further particulars respecting
Yar Mohamed we have been unable to obtain any information
as to his activities.

W Duncan.
D. S. I.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

（批：Mg 29.7.30.）

档案编号。
S.B. D 1455。

报告
特二科（Special Branch No. 2 Station），
日期：1930年7月29日。

事由（全称）：自1926年1月以来当地海关当局查获的武器。

由副督察长邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）撰写并呈送。

先生：
关于附上的孟买警方1930年6月26日来信，涉及过去五年走私武器查获情况，谨此呈上自1926年1月至今由海关当局及水警查获的所有武器清单。
在此期间，上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）也进行了多次查获，尽管众所周知这些武器必定是走私进入上海的，但由于枪支在被查获前通常已几经转手，因此无法追溯其来源。
由于缺乏关于亚尔·穆罕默德（Yar Mohamed）的进一步详情，我们未能获取有关其活动的任何信息。

W. 邓肯
副督察长

助理处长
（刑事与情报科）

（批注：Mg 1930年7月29日。）

THE/COMMISSIONER OF POLICE,
Crime Branch, BOMBAY.

To
The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai, China.

Bombay, June 1930.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that in recent years large
consignments of arms and ammunition have been seized on incoming
ships by the Bombay Police and Customs authorities. Inquiries made
go to show that most of these smuggled arms are intended for sale
in China where they realize a good price.

I would, therefore, request you kindly to supply me with
a statement giving the undermentioned details regarding any cases
of arms smuggling detected by you during the past five years.
(1) Name of ship, (2) Quantity of arms seized,
(3) Date of seizure, (4) Names of persons arrested,
(5) Result of case,

One Yar Mohamed, a Ghat Serang of the P. & O. Company, -
Bombay, is believed to be responsible for a great deal of this -
smuggling and I would request you to supply me with any information
you may possess regarding the man.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your most obedient servant,

Dy: Commissioner of Police,
R26/6 Crime Branch, Bombay.

孟买，1930年6月。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，近年来，孟买警方和海关当局在入境船只上查获了大量武器和弹药。经调查表明，这些走私武器大多 intended for sale in China（拟在中国出售），在那里能卖得好价钱。

因此，恳请阁下提供一份说明，列明贵处在过去五年中查获的任何武器走私案件的以下细节：(1) 船名，(2) 查获武器数量，(3) 查获日期，(4) 被捕人员姓名，(5) 案件结果。

一名叫 Yar Mohamed 的人，系孟买半岛与东方航运公司（P. & O. Company）的码头工头（Ghat Serang），据信对大部分此类走私活动负责。恳请阁下提供您所掌握的关于此人的任何信息。

谨此致意，
先生，
您最顺从的仆人，

副警务处处长，
R26/6 刑事处，孟买。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTER
No. S. B. D. 1455.
Date 31 - 7 - 30.

July 30, 30.

Sir,

In reply to your letter No. 4860 of June 26, I have the
honour to forward herewith a list of arms seized during the
past five years. The list probably contains only a portion
of the actual seizures made by the local Customs officials
and River Police, and does not include arms and ammunition
seized by the Shanghai Municipal Police in the Foreign
Settlement which were undoubtedly smuggled ashore for sale
and in which there was no possibility of tracing the source
of supply.

For your information it should be noted that the Shanghai
Municipal Police have no jurisdiction on the Whangpoo River
where ships berth so that we are dependent on the local
Chinese River Police and Customs Authorities for most of
the information contained in the attached list. For that
reason we can obtain no information regarding Yar Mohamed,
as smuggling is done outside our jurisdiction and we have
no means of getting into touch with the principals.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime Branch,
Bombay. India.

（批：C.30）

供阁下参考，需注意的是，上海公共租界工部局警务处在船舶停泊的黄浦江上没有管辖权，因此附件清单中的大部分信息依赖于当地中国水上警察和海关当局。正因如此，我们无法获得关于 Yar Mohamed 的任何信息，因为走私行为发生在我们管辖范围之外，我们没有办法联系到主要涉案人员。

谨此致意，
